parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the outer shell and internal supports.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and support for all other components such as shelves, doors, and drawers.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire cabinet together.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of MDF.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the internal space into sections for better organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and conceals stored items when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a box-like component that slides in and out of the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides enclosed storage for smaller items and is frequently accessed by users.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along metal or wooden slides for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the entire cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains stationary during use.
